notes.title: BUGfix and improvement of player operation
notes.content:
BUGfix and improvement of player operation
[olist]
Fix the gap between characters and physical ground
Fix the overlap problem between player character and NPCs
Fix the problem that player character may perform strange after dead
Improve the jumping action performance of player character
Improve the landing action performance of player character
Improve the operation logic of elevator in stage
Improve the operation logic of conversation options
Improve the presentation of player character's status
Improve the scrolling speed of the story text
Add "Push Any Key To Continue" to the loading scene
Improve the window popup animation in the map scene
Improve the operation logic in the map scene
Improve the setup logic of player module and plugin
Add then "Restart stage" option in the GameOver window
Improve then notice text before Quit the game
Adjust then size of characters and objects in stage
[/olist]
